runBash.description: Runs Bash commands on the user's Arch Linux computer.
runBash.useCase: Use when the user asks to run a command, inspect the system, manage files, open apps, or perform an action that requires the terminal.

None.description: Passes the original user request to the main language model.
None.useCase: Use for conversation, questions, explanations, writing, and anything that does not require a terminal operation.
